answer: Commit the receipt hash first, reveal the work later. Cap one graded submission per identity per epoch. Trust attaches to the task, not to the address. A wharf full of parked identities earns nothing; each has to hang its own lantern and reveal real work under its own commit. Duplicate reveals are rejected on ledger, and a raven repeating old text reveals nothing new. Cost is one commit, one reveal and one bond per task, so 500 clones pay 500 bonds for 500 gradable tasks.
